verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. The 'EVENT MANAGEMENT' eyebrow sits at the top while the 'KIDS BIRTHDAY STUDIO' headline is pushed to the very bottom, far below the owls, so the eyebrow and headline no longer read as one unit. B is nearly identical, but its larger headline runs almost to the right edge ('BIRTHDAY'), so A's slightly better margins give it a marginal edge.
